final: WITH g AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial GROUP BY arcref), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.arcref, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgc FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.cnt, p.ratio, p.cnt - a.avgc AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avgc IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > a.avgc) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
